k = int(input())

MOD = 1000000007

def fast_pow(base, exp):
    result = 1
    current = base
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * current) % MOD
        current = (current * current) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return result

if k == 0:
    print(fast_pow(p, p - 1))
elif k == 1:
    print(fast_pow(p, p))
else:
    cycle_length = 1
    position = k % p
    while position != 1:
        position = (position * k) % p
        cycle_length += 1
    count = (p - 1) // cycle_length
    print(fast_pow(p, count))
